name: Match
description: Find card trios with all-matching or all-different features.

rules.title: How to Play
rules.rule1: Find three cards. For each feature, the three cards must be all the same or all different.
rules.rule2: Each card has 4 properties: shape, color, fill, and count
rules.rule3: Select three cards that form a valid trio.

hint: Select three cards to check if they form a valid trio.
